<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Billowing Wings](/Feats.aspx?ID=5433) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=527" />
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 67

**Archetype** [Beastmaster](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=50)

**Prerequisites**
[Beastmaster Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=1900); animal companion with wings

</column>

---

You've trained your winged companions to gather air in their wings, whipping up a concentrated gust of wind at opponents, potentially staggering them. Your companions with wings gain a gust ranged [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) attack, which deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage with a range of 30 feet and has the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=527) and [propulsive](/Traits.aspx?ID=677) traits. On a critical hit, the target is [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) back 5 feet. This is forced movement.
name: Billowing Wings
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with wings
